description: A valid component variant spec names the component, declares at least 2 variants with a default, uses only token references, and covers all theme modes.

rules.description: At least one variant must be the default. Without a default, the component has no fallback visual and will break when no variant prop is passed.
Every variant must have a unique id. Duplicate IDs make variants unreferable and cause implementation ambiguity.
The component field must be a non-empty string. This is the canonical component identifier used by the IR and downstream compilers.
A component with only one visual variant does not need a variant system — it should just be a single component style. Two or more variants justify the spec.
